title.zh: What Is Arc? The Stablecoin Blockchain From USDC Issuer Circle
title.en: What Is Arc? The Stablecoin Blockchain From USDC Issuer Circle

current_state.zh: Circle's USDC-focused layer-1 blockchain Arc opened to the public on September 16, 2026, offering USDC gas, a built-in FX engine, and opt-in privacy to support institutional stablecoin applications.
current_state.en: Circle's USDC-focused layer-1 blockchain Arc opened to the public on September 16, 2026, offering USDC gas, a built-in FX engine, and opt-in privacy to support institutional stablecoin applications.
